rawText:
Elena Rostova
Senior Frontend Engineer
Seattle, WA | elena.rostova@example.test

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Frontend engineer with 5 years specializing in reactive user interfaces, performance profiling, responsive design systems, and state management architectures using React, TypeScript, and Next.js.

EXPERIENCE
Prism Interactive | Senior Frontend Engineer
2022 - Present
- Built modular design system component library in React, TypeScript, and Storybook adopted across 6 product teams.
- Improved Google Lighthouse Core Web Vitals score from 61 to 94 by code-splitting bundles and optimizing critical rendering paths.
- Led frontend technical direction for real-time collaboration canvas using WebSockets and HTML5 Canvas.
- Mentored 4 frontend apprentices on TypeScript static typing patterns and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) standards.

Beacon Analytics | Frontend Developer
2019 - 2022
- Developed high-performance financial data visualization dashboards using React, Redux Toolkit, and D3.js.
- Decreased initial page load bundle payload by 45% through dynamic lazy-loading and tree-shaking unused dependencies.
- Implemented client-side caching and optimistic updates with TanStack Query, cutting perceived network lag by 60%.
- Authored 120+ automated integration and end-to-end tests using Vitest and Cypress, ensuring 85% component branch coverage.

SKILLS
Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Storybook, HTML5, CSS3
Data Visualization: D3.js, Chart.js, Canvas API
Testing & Tooling: Vitest, Jest, Cypress, Vite, Webpack, Git

EDUCATION
University of Washington
B.S. in Informatics (2015 - 2019)
